name: nestjs-filters
description: Production-ready, modular Exception Filters for NestJS to handle HTTP, TypeORM, and unhandled system errors gracefully.

variants.name: http-only
variants.description: Catches standard NestJS HTTP exceptions and formats them with standardized JSON responses and lightweight logging.

variants.name: global-catchall
variants.description: Catches all unhandled system exceptions (500 Internal Server Error) to prevent app crashes and sensitive data leaks.

variants.name: typeorm
variants.description: Catches TypeORM-specific errors (e.g., unique constraint violations) and maps them to standard HTTP conflict responses.
